theme: 3 terms on sharing from an app: the panel, the content, and the view controller that shows it

terms.definition: The panel that slides up so the user can send content to another app.
terms.example: Tap Share to open the Share Sheet.

terms.definition: A piece of content, such as text or a link, that you want to share.
terms.example: Add the note text and its link as Activity Items.

terms.definition: A built-in view controller that shows the share sheet with your items.
terms.example: Create an Activity View Controller and present it from the button action.

video.title: Share Sheet, Activity Item & Activity View Controller | Day 127
video.description:
Learn to explain how an iOS app shares content with other apps: Share Sheet, Activity Item & Activity View Controller, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Share Sheet - The panel that slides up so the user can send content to another app.
Activity Item - A piece of content, such as text or a link, that you want to share.
Activity View Controller - A built-in view controller that shows the share sheet with your items.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 127 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

Explain Share Sheet, Activity Item & Activity View Controller in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

Share Sheet - The panel that slides up so the user can send content to another app.
한국어: 셰어 시트: 사용자가 콘텐츠를 다른 앱으로 보내도록 올라오는 패널

한국어: 액티비티 아이템: 공유하려는 텍스트나 링크 같은 콘텐츠 하나

Activity View Controller - A built-in view controller that shows the share sheet with your items.
한국어: 액티비티 뷰 컨트롤러: 내 항목과 함께 공유 시트를 보여 주는 기본 뷰 컨트롤러

landscape.hook: Can you explain Share Sheet, Activity Item and Activity View Controller in English?

dialogue.title: A Share button

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want a Share button on the note screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the Share Sheet. It is the standard panel for sending content.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Create an Activity View Controller and present it, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your Activity Items. For example, text and a link.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I put a string and a `url` in the `items` array.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Each Activity Item must be a type the sheet understands.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The Share Sheet needs a source view for its popover, or it crashes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Always test the Activity View Controller on iPad too.

dialogue.code:
let items: [Any] = ["Check this note", url]
let sheet = UIActivityViewController(
    activityItems: items,
    applicationActivities: nil)
vc.present(sheet, animated: true)
